.. change::
    :tags: feature, revision
    :tickets: 1515

    Added a read-only revision selection interface,
    :meth:`.RevisionMap.select_revisions` (also available as
    :meth:`.ScriptDirectory.select_revisions`).  Given target revision(s)
    or branch label(s), it returns a :class:`.RevisionSelection` of every
    required ancestor in a stable topological order, with a
    :class:`.SelectionReason` edge for every requirement produced by
    ``down_revision`` or ``depends_on``.  Duplicate targets are merged;
    explicitly excluding a required ancestor raises
    :class:`.RequiredRevisionExcluded` rather than silently dropping the
    dependency; missing target revisions, missing ``down_revision`` /
    ``depends_on`` references and cyclic revision graphs each produce a
    clear, specific error.  A new :class:`.RevisionReferenceNotFound`
    error is now raised when the revision map references a revision that
    is not present, instead of an opaque ``KeyError``.
